hypotheses.claim: NEEDS_CLARIFICATION is a terminal dead-end in the shipped app: no client anywhere calls POST /api/vouchers/:id/resubmit, so an SE whose claim is sent back can never move it forward.
hypotheses.strongestAlternative: The SE simply files a fresh voucher instead, so the stranded row is cosmetic clutter rather than lost money.
hypotheses.altCheck: grep -rn 'resubmit' apps/mobile/src apps/admin/src packages — only prose comments, a LeaveRequest note and an unrelated troubleshoot test; no apiResubmitVoucher wrapper exists in apps/mobile/src/api/client.ts. A refile also re-triggers VCH-01, so the alternative is worse, not benign.

hypotheses.claim: A single Operations Head account can approve a voucher and then mark it PAID, because OPERATIONS_HEAD sits in REVIEW_ROLES and markPaid never reads voucher.reviewedBy.
hypotheses.strongestAlternative: A guard, interceptor or seeded role policy outside this module blocks an OH from the review route in practice.
hypotheses.altCheck: read apps/backend/src/vouchers/vouchers.controller.ts:57-136 — only AuthGuard + RoleGuard, no extra @UseGuards on review; and vouchers.service.ts:252 shows the module's one self-dealing guard is SE-only (actor.userId === voucher.seId), which would be redundant if a broader SoD policy existed.

hypotheses.claim: A real double-tap or retry after a network drop creates two vouchers and two reimbursements, because the mobile form mints a fresh clientSubmissionId on every submit attempt.
hypotheses.strongestAlternative: The submitting flag disables the button, so a second submit is impossible in practice and the id's lifetime does not matter.
hypotheses.altCheck: read VoucherFormScreen.tsx:39,43,89 — `submitting` is cleared in the finally block, so the button re-enables the moment the request errors or times out, which is exactly the retry case; and the sibling convention at TroubleshootFormScreen.test.tsx:101 asserts a NEW id on a second submit, so the behaviour is intended repo-wide.

hypotheses.claim: Every voucher reaches the ZM queue carrying warning NO_ACTIVITY_LINK, because the mobile form posts no ticketId, plantId or vehicleId, making the fraud control unusable noise.
hypotheses.strongestAlternative: Vouchers are created from a ticket context elsewhere (a TicketDetailScreen entry point) that does pass the anchor.
hypotheses.altCheck: SPINE E-15 in static.md:22 already records the carrier as 'a human remembers — SE opens the Vouchers tab and re-keys the trip', with no ticket carrier from TicketDetailScreen; VoucherFormScreenProps at :16-19 takes only onSubmitted/onCancel, so the screen cannot receive a ticket.

retired.claim: The SE receives no notification on reject, clarification or payment — the notifier only writes a server log — while the ZM's screen states the SE is notified.
retired.retiredBecause: settled by code after the conductor's correction prompted a module-binding read. vouchers.module.ts:18 binds VOUCHER_NOTIFIER useClass LoggingVoucherNotifier unconditionally — no env switch, no second VoucherNotifier implementation in the module. The strongest alternative (a real notifier swapped in for production) is dead, so this is no longer a claim code cannot settle. Carried as gap VCH-07 at E2/HIGH instead.
